Protests and Riots Sweep Across Europe

Violent protests and unrest have been reported across Europe, with incidents occurring in Paris, France, and Tirana, among other locations. Tourists in Paris have been navigating the city amidst the demonstrations. The United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights has condemned the violence associated with these protests.
